scope: Weeks 1-4 of the proposal only: P1 steps 1-3, P2 falsification gate (+ proof attempt only if QU-1 survives), P3 core library, P6 data + Feynman-Bijl, P7 steps 1-3. P4, P5/H9 and P1 steps 4-5 are deferred to a second workflow.
method: Elenchus: tiers A/L/C/X; claims ledger per paper with the gate run; producer != verifier (independent audit on a tier no cheaper than the producer); positive + negative controls for every experiment; Karpathy-style time-boxed attempts, binary keep/discard with the Lean kernel as judge (whitelist axioms, planted controls caught). Publication only if the audit is not REJECT, the revision is applied and the paper still has a result; negative results are published.

lanes.title: Independent reproduction of the finite certificate and adversarial audit of the reduction in openai/math's claimed proof of the Sandier-Serfaty conjecture; locked Lean statement; LeanFlow fail-closed Lean data-certificate generator
statements: S1: run-certificate.py (sources unchanged) exits 0 with terminal OK, sources_unchanged true and stage_validation passed on our hardware (launched 2026-10-25 ~20:25 UTC, detached, cores 0-3, output /home/callensxavier_gmail_com/programmes-2026-10-25/P1/certificate-run).
S1-neg: in a separate copy, loosening one analytic bound used by the certificate makes the run fail (rejects), showing the certificate is sensitive to it.
S2: each analytic step of the reduction (manuscript Sections 2-5) is either confirmed step by step or a specific gap is identified (location, missing hypothesis).

S3: a Lean statement of the Sandier-Serfaty conjecture (renormalized energy over admissible curl-free fields with unit background, triangular lattice minimal), compiled, with a non-vacuity check; locked by sha256.
S4: LeanFlow lean.* data-certificate generator prototype that fails closed (missing target, non-zero rc or non-whitelisted axiom are errors, each with a test).
lanes.kill: S1 fails to reproduce -> report; S2 gap found -> second independent Opus audit before any wording; never claim the conjecture proved on our authority
lanes.paper_scope: independent reproduction of the finite certificate + adversarial audit of the reduction (+ Lean statement); not 'verified', not 'proved'

lanes.title: Quantum universal optimality QU-1: is the triangular lattice the minimizer of the harmonic zero-point energy among unit-covolume planar Bravais lattices for every completely monotone potential?
statements: G1 (falsification gate, Tier X): over the fundamental domain of lattice shapes, for Gaussian (several alpha), Yukawa, dipolar-exciton and Riesz s>2 potentials, the triangular lattice has the lowest E_zp = 1/2 sum_k sum_branches omega(k) (k-grid converged, k=0 handled, neutralising background for long range). Negative control: a non-CM potential where another lattice has lower E_zp.
G2 (only if G1 survives): human proof among lattices for Gaussian potentials (theta-function route), then Lean formalization of whatever is proved.
lanes.kill: a converged counterexample refutes QU-1 for that potential (publishable negative result); G2 stalls after two budgets -> keep Tier C
